entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of detach procedure. It is a type 1 information element with specific coding for UE-to-network and network-to-UE directions.

entities.name: Detach type IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier field for the Detach type IE, occupying bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Switch off
entities.description: Bit field indicating whether the detach is due to switch off (UE-to-network) or spare (network-to-UE). Occupies bit 4 of octet 1.

entities.name: Type of detach
entities.description: Bit field encoding the specific type of detach procedure. Occupies bits 3-1 of octet 1 with different interpretations for UE-to-network and network-to-UE directions.

entities.name: EPS detach
entities.description: Condition when type of detach bits are set to 001 in UE-to-network direction, indicating EPS detach procedure.

entities.name: IMSI detach
entities.description: Condition when type of detach bits are set to 010 in UE-to-network direction or 011 in network-to-UE direction, indicating IMSI detach procedure.

entities.name: Combined EPS/IMSI detach
entities.description: Condition when type of detach bits are set to 011 in UE-to-network direction, indicating combined EPS/IMSI detach procedure.

entities.name: Re-attach required
entities.description: Condition when type of detach bits are set to 001 in network-to-UE direction, indicating re-attach is required.

entities.name: Re-attach not required
entities.description: Condition when type of detach bits are set to 010 in network-to-UE direction, indicating re-attach is not required.

entities.name: Switch off detach
entities.description: Condition when switch off bit is set to 1 in UE-to-network direction, indicating detach due to switch off.

entities.name: Normal detach
entities.description: Condition when switch off bit is set to 0 in UE-to-network direction, indicating normal detach procedure.

relations.description: The Detach type information element contains the IEI field as part of its structure.
The Detach type information element contains the Switch off field as part of its structure.
The Detach type information element contains the Type of detach field as part of its structure.
The Type of detach field is guarded by the EPS detach condition when bits are set to 001 in UE-to-network direction.
The Type of detach field is guarded by the IMSI detach condition when bits are set to 010 in UE-to-network direction or 011 in network-to-UE direction.
The Type of detach field is guarded by the combined EPS/IMSI detach condition when bits are set to 011 in UE-to-network direction.
The Type of detach field is guarded by the re-attach required condition when bits are set to 001 in network-to-UE direction.
The Type of detach field is guarded by the re-attach not required condition when bits are set to 010 in network-to-UE direction.
The Switch off field is guarded by the switch off detach condition when bit is set to 1 in UE-to-network direction.
The Switch off field is guarded by the normal detach condition when bit is set to 0 in UE-to-network direction.
